name: Camden
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Camden, NJ 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Camden, New Jersey for 2026: waterfront tree lighting, Santa at Battleship New Jersey, an aquarium Christmas and free parades.
lede: Camden celebrates on the Delaware waterfront, with a county tree lighting beside Adventure Aquarium, Santa aboard a battleship and Scuba Santa under the sea.
celebrates: Camden County and the City of Camden host the main community celebration on the Camden Waterfront, where a motorcade brings Santa Claus to the Aquarium Loop and the Camden County Tree Lighting follows, according to the county. Adventure Aquarium runs Christmas Underwater from November 20 through December 24, with Scuba Santa, indoor snow flurries every hour on the hour and what it calls the world's tallest underwater Christmas tree in the 550,000-gallon Shark Realm. Battleship New Jersey and the Camden County Police Department each add their own Santa evening, and the county's holiday calendar also lists nearby Gloucester City and Pennsauken.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap of the Camden waterfront tree lighting, so this page leans on the host pages for 2026. Adventure Aquarium describes Christmas Underwater as the most unique holiday tradition in the Philadelphia area and presents it with Shriners Children's Philadelphia, which tells us the event returns each season. The aquarium also lists a Merry Fishmas puppet show for little ones and a Fishmas Sing-Along led by its helpers.
facts: The Adventure Aquarium says its Shark Realm exhibit holds 550,000 gallons of water and the largest collection of sharks in the Northeast, and that is where the tallest underwater Christmas tree stands. The aquarium also lets kids write letters to Scuba Santa and take part in a winter scavenger hunt where everyone who joins wins a prize. In the Rotunda, a 20 foot Christmas tree sits in a room where indoor snow falls every hour. Battleship New Jersey sits on the same Camden waterfront.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Camden itself. Our New Jersey guide at /blog/christmas-train-ride-new-jersey lists the Christmas train rides across the state, and families who want a train day often cross the river to Philadelphia, where the holiday railway at Morris Arboretum and other displays run. Battleship New Jersey's All Aboard for Santa is a ship visit, not a train ride, but kids who love big machines tend to enjoy it.
traditions: The county's tree lighting on the waterfront opens with a Santa motorcade, winter village food and live music.
Adventure Aquarium adds Scuba Santa, hourly indoor snow and an underwater Christmas tree from November 20 to December 24.
Battleship New Jersey hosts a Santa evening aboard the ship.
Winter Wonderland at the police department
The Camden County Police Department opens its doors for a free evening with Santa.
Gloucester City and Pennsauken hold their own free winter wonderland and holiday parade.
kidfact: At Adventure Aquarium the tallest Christmas tree in the world stands underwater, and Santa wears scuba gear to visit it.
faq: The waterfront hosts the Camden County Tree Lighting with a Santa motorcade, and Adventure Aquarium adds Scuba Santa and indoor snow during Christmas Underwater. Battleship New Jersey and the county police department each hold a Santa evening, and nearby Gloucester City and Pennsauken run their own parade and winter wonderland.
Is there something to do indoors in Camden at Christmas?

Yes. Adventure Aquarium is indoors, and the aquarium says Christmas Underwater is included with general admission. It runs November 20 through December 24 and has a puppet show, a sing-along, a scavenger hunt and indoor snow every hour on the hour.
Where do families meet Santa in Camden?

Families can meet Santa at the waterfront tree lighting, at the Battleship New Jersey Santa evening, at the Camden County Police Department winter wonderland and at the Gloucester City event. Each host lists its own hours, so check the listing for the time before you go.
Are there free Christmas events near Camden?

Yes. The Pennsauken Holiday Parade, the Gloucester City winter wonderland and the Camden County Police Department event are free. The waterfront festival does not print a price, so check the county page for ride and food costs.
What should we bring to the waterfront events?

Bring warm layers, because the Camden Waterfront is open to the river wind, and plan for parking near the Aquarium Loop. The county notes ride and food costs can add up, so a small budget for the winter village is a good idea.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Camden for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Christmas Underwater at Adventure Aquarium) through December 24, with the Pennsauken Holiday Parade (November 28), All Aboard for Santa at Battleship New Jersey (December 4), the Winter Wonderland Festival and Tree Lighting at the Camden Waterfront (December 5), the Winter Wonderland at Proprietors Park in Gloucester City (December 12) and the Winter Wonderland at the Camden County Police Department (December 17) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Camden

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Camden and nearby Gloucester City and Pennsauken
  • 3 free events: the Pennsauken Holiday Parade, the Gloucester City Winter Wonderland and the Winter Wonderland at the Camden County Police Department
  • Meet Santa: All Aboard for Santa at Battleship New Jersey (December 4), the Santa motorcade at the Camden Waterfront (December 5), Gloucester City (December 12) and the police department (December 17)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Pennsauken Holiday Parade (November 28) and the Camden County Tree Lighting at the Waterfront (December 5)
  • Attractions: Christmas Underwater at Adventure Aquarium with Scuba Santa (November 20 to December 24)
  • Season: November 20 to December 24

Planning a bigger day out? Camden families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Philadelphia, which covers the Philadelphia Christmas Village, the Franklin Square Electrical Spectacle and the Morris Arboretum Holiday Garden Railway.
